title: Bot Registers Its Own Job Account, Skips the Login Wall | vitalii.no
description:
Some Norwegian job sites, like Webcruiter and Recman, don't let anyone apply without first creating a candidate account — there's no guest path at all. Our automated job-application bot treated that wall as a dead end: policy said never open a browser there, so a strong match on one of the country's most common ATS platforms simply never got applied to.

POLICY v11 flips that logic: checking for an account is now the first step, not the reason to bail. A new helper looks up existing site credentials, logs in if one exists, or registers a fresh account using the bot's own mailbox when none does. It waits for the confirmation e-mail over IMAP, follows the link, then drives the resulting account through the real application form — importing the master CV once and filling every section: personal details, questions, cover letter.

Before this, the count of automatic applications completed on Webcruiter was zero — the account wall stopped every attempt before it began. In a live, no-send test the bot completed the whole flow end to end: account, e-mail confirmation, CV import, every field filled and ready to submit.
